nodes.rationale: 3D-style illustration of two identical blue classical bank buildings (columned facades with bank emblem in pediment) connected by a red curved arrow pointing left-to-right, visually communicating moving a mortgage/loan from one bank to another (KPR take-over / refinancing). Blue and red palette on transparent background; used as a service-category icon at 256px.
